story_theme_en: A race has 9 runners. Lin finishes in 2nd place. Mali finishes last in 9th place. How many runners finished behind Lin?
helper_tip_en: Read the story carefully. Find the numbers and the question. Then use addition or subtraction to solve it.
think_story_en: Lin is 2nd. Last is 9th. Runners behind Lin: 9 - 2 = 7 runners.
